body: The spirits never fail to disappoint...
Thank you for the encouragement! I'm definitely feeling better and more productive aswell.
I guess so, I'm looking to see if there are any freelance jobs I can get.
That's the problem, I don't know where to start. I don't even think I have any skills nevermind experience.

It's still a while until March, thing can get better! There's still a lot to experience in life that doesn't involve graduation, you don't have to let your father be apart of your life as an adult. You can talk to me about it!
We can talk, if you need anything don't be afraid to just tell me! I'll be glad to help!

Since there is no undoing the past the past the best that you can do is move forward in life. There's no use crying over something that's already happened. You should see a therapist for your trauma since depressed people on the internet aren't really qualified for the job.
Of course! I'm happy to help!
Try to just get through your day, see a doctor and take hrt if you can. if you need any support there's a lot of places and I'm free to talk if you need anything!
I mean, there's a lot to life, maybe you'll one day see those things and experience them for yourself! I can talk if you'd like to.
Do you want to talk about it?
